rounds.text: While reported profits look strong, the company suffers from a significant disconnect between earnings and actual cash generation, evidenced by a cash conversion ratio of just 0.43x for March 2026 where profits sit far ahead of cash, pointing to potential issues with receivables and accruals [E28]. This cash strain is further highlighted by a staggering free cash flow of Rs -68 Cr in March 2026 [E30], coinciding with a massive +684.6% surge in capital work-in-progress to Rs 102 Cr that exposes the business to heavy execution and completion risks [E34]. Expectations are also running dangerously ahead of fundamental delivery, with recent price growth exceeding profit growth by 42% [E51] and the stock hovering 88% up its 52-week range [E5, E42]. Furthermore, operating margins are flagged as inconsistent over both the last 1 year and the last 2 quarters [E26, E27], while promoter shareholding has drifted downward from 55.09% in March 2024 to 53.02% by June 2026 [E35]. Conceded: the company carries virtually no debt with borrowings at just Rs 1 Cr [E32, E33], and boasts impressive multi-year profit compounding [E17, E18, E55].

Conceded: cash conversion sits at 0.43x with a free cash flow of Rs -68 Cr [E28, E30], but this cash deployment directly powers a massive +684.6% surge in capital work-in-progress to Rs 102 Cr [E34], representing aggressive growth and capacity expansion rather than structural distress. Conceded: operating margins read as inconsistent [E26, E27], yet the broader operating margin has actually expanded to 16% in Mar 2026 compared to 10% three years prior [E24]. Conceded: promoters trimmed their stake to 53.02% [E35], but this minor reduction has been aggressively absorbed by institutional capital flows, with foreign and domestic institutions increasing their combined holdings alongside a positive institutional money flow signal [E36, E37, E38]. Conceded: price growth has recently run ahead of profit growth [E51], but this reflects strong momentum backed by a rules-based screen score of 99 out of 100 [E56] and a robust discounted cash flow intrinsic value pointing to a 33.9% margin of safety [E39, E40].

Conceded: Capital work-in-progress surged by +684.6% to reach Rs 102 Cr [E34], but this massive buildup directly triggered a severe free cash flow deficit of Rs -68 Cr and a weak cash conversion ratio of 0.43x [E28, E30]. While the bull frames this as healthy expansion, profits are running far ahead of actual cash collection, pointing straight to potential risks in receivables and accruals [E28]. Conceded: Operating margin expanded over a three-year window [E24], yet the yearly and quarterly operational trends are officially classified as inconsistent [E26, E27], undermining the stability of those margin gains. Conceded: Domestic and foreign institutions increased their holdings [E36, E37], but promoters still actively trimmed their stake from 55.09% to 53.02% [E35]. Finally, the claim that momentum and screens justify the valuation ignores the clear warning that price growth has run 42% ahead of profit growth, leaving expectations dangerously far out in front of actual delivery [E51].
